comments.value: Hey I want to point out that there is a workaround for this, and it doesn't require a humanoid avatar. This workaround is to add an active animator with "apply root motion" checked to the world fixed joint. To make it active, have the animator component on by default and add any controller reference. The controller itself can be empty.
